title: Confidence in divine presence
odia:
ଡର କାହାକୁ ଭୟ କାହାକୁ
ଠାକୁର ଅଛନ୍ତି ଚଉବାହାକୁ।
literal_meaning: Whom should one fear, whom should one dread? The Lord is there on all four sides.
meaning_odia: କାହାକୁ ଡରିବା, କାହାକୁ ଭୟ କରିବା—ଠାକୁର ଚାରିଆଡ଼େ ଅଛନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ବକ୍ତା ସାହସ ପାଉଛନ୍ତି। ଏଠାରେ ଚଉବାହାକୁ ଶବ୍ଦକୁ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଅନୁସାରେ ଚାରିଆଡ଼େ ଅର୍ଥରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ଭଗବାନଙ୍କ ସାନ୍ନିଧ୍ୟରେ ଭରସା ରଖି ମନର ଭୟ କମାଇବାର ଏହା ଭକ୍ତିପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଉକ୍ତି।
explanation: The repeated question answers fear with confidence in the Lord’s presence. We read ଚଉବାହାକୁ contextually as on all four sides; the devotional compound can also evoke the four-armed Lord, so this rendering does not resolve every possible nuance. The couplet voices reassurance rather than establishing that danger cannot occur.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Before beginning a difficult journey, a believer repeats the couplet to steady their mind while making the practical preparations the journey requires.
cultural_context: ଡର and ଭୟ repeat the same concern with increasing emphasis. The second line supplies the believer’s answer: the Lord is present around them. The source leaves the deity unnamed.

witnesses.locator: Page21, opening couplet beginning ଡର କାହାକୁ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact wording retained. ଚଉବାହାକୁ is contextually rendered on all four sides. The spatial rendering is contextual; no named deity inferred.

odia_summary: ଠାକୁରଙ୍କ ସାନ୍ନିଧ୍ୟରେ ଭରସା ରଖି ଭୟର ସାମନା କରିବା।
english_summary: Faith in divine presence gives the speaker courage.
